<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 179.0946, which in positive‑mode ESI likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few millidaltons is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass 178.0841 Da), which is the best fit among reasonable C/H/O combinations.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
